scenes.text: Something in this room is changing. You have ten seconds.
Did you catch it? The curtains. They were red.
The lamp. It faded away, right in front of you.
Final round. Almost nobody gets this one.
The yellow pillow. It slid across the couch.
And that little frame? It was green.
Two changes. At the same time.
So how many did you catch, out of four? Now watch it again.
